SocialObservation records are §30-observable, tenant-scoped, source-attributed WHAT-THE-PLATFORM-SAID records — never invented, never transformed into causal claims (attribution/causality is ATTRIB-001's later domain). No real network: SocialTransportPort is a declared seam with a disclosed deterministic self-labelling in-memory double; §30 records cover every attributable attempt. Provider specifics live in DATA, never in code (test-pinned).
